name: Sparse ruler of length 200 with the fewest marks
description: construct() -> distinct integer marks in 0..200 such that every distance 1..200 is a difference of two marks. Minimize the number of marks; the optimum is 25. For N = 200 the minimum is 25, so the task recovers an optimal ruler.
